structural_facts.note: a (company, t_*) cell can never satisfy the 510k/pma label, so trial-track cells are structurally always-negative rows; likewise any cell whose only events are recalls or drug approvals

interpretation_hint: The frozen task keeps all cells, so these numbers are sensitivities only; they answer 'does the conclusion survive on the cells that can actually be positive?'. H5 is different: its added features are identically zero on every device-capable cell, so H5 has zero within-cell identifiability regardless of the sample.
